desc: Derive prefix-sum reduction: smoke at V at time t iff P_t - P_e = V for some e <= t, i.e. P_t - V already visited.
Remove conditional regeneration by arguing that unconditionally occupying the origin does not change the occupied set.
Implement the online prefix-set solution: seed set with (0,0), update P per wind char, check (P-(R,C)) membership, emit bit, then insert P; print N bits.
Run all three provided samples and confirm exact outputs 001010, 0001101011, 00100111111000101111.
